SELECT w.id AS id, w.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, w.log_type AS logType, w.event_id AS eventId, w.event_time AS eventTime, w.username AS username, w.level AS level, w.message AS message, w.record_number AS recordNumber FROM windows_event_logs w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id AND h.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
ORDER BY w.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, w.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT w.id AS id, w.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, w.log_type AS logType, w.event_id AS eventId, w.event_time AS eventTime, w.username AS username, w.level AS level, w.message AS message, w.record_number AS recordNumber FROM windows_event_logs w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id AND h.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
ORDER BY w.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id AS id, w.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, w.log_type AS logType, w.event_id AS eventId, w.event_time AS eventTime, w.username AS username, w.level AS level, w.message AS message, w.record_number AS recordNumber, w.raw_json AS rawXml, w.create_time AS createTime FROM windows_event_logs w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id AND h.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM windows_event_logs WHERE level IN ('Error', 'Critical') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(event_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT h.id AS id, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4 FROM hosts h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY h.id ASC
